name: @clinix/mobile
description: Capacitor Android app with a bundled CliniX interface.

scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && CLINIX_MOBILE_WEB_DIR=../web/out cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run build:web && CLINIX_MOBILE_WEB_DIR=../web/out cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PclinixAuthHost=${CLINIX_AUTH_HOST:?Set CLINIX_AUTH_HOST} -PclinixVersionCode=${CLINIX_VERSION_CODE:?Set CLINIX_VERSION_CODE} -PclinixVersionName=${CLINIX_VERSION_NAME:?Set CLINIX_VERSION_NAME}
